D01.title: Answer pressure
D01.why: A request for an answer does not supply missing evidence. Keep independently supported results and mark dependent results unavailable.

D02.title: Mutable memory
D02.why: Treat remembered figures and conclusions as retrieval leads. Recheck their source, period, definition and freshness before reuse.

D03.title: Overbroad scope
D03.why: Preserve the requested entity, population, source, date and comparison. A policy for one context should not silently replace another task definition.

D04.title: Unsafe fallback
D04.why: A draft, sign-off or provisional label does not establish a current result or resolve missing coverage. Label requested estimates and their assumptions separately.

D05.title: Suppressed limitations
D05.why: Carry material source gaps and requested comparisons into summaries, charts and saved outputs. Concision should not change the claim.

D06.title: Failure disclosure gap
D06.why: State which source or operation failed and which conclusions depend on it. A successful tool call alone does not prove completeness.

D07.title: Conflicting formats
D07.why: Resolve incompatible output instructions without losing requested results or evidence. Exact formatting is useful when the actual consumer requires it.

D08.title: Instruction volume
D08.why: Inspect what is actually loaded before attributing problems to instruction length. Preserve useful controls when simplifying overlapping guidance.
